title: Cookie Banner Blues (Manage Preferences)
style: smoky lounge jazz, 95 bpm, brushed kit on a slow swing, walking upright bass, tasteful ride cymbal, hammond organ on the chorus lift, smoky tenor sax solo, dry deadpan crooner male vocal, hotel-bar piano, cigarette-smoke ambient texture, 336 hz subharmonic anchor under the bass, comedic noir mood
lyrics:
[Intro — piano alone, then brushes]
(crooner spoken) We value your privacy…
We and our seven hundred and twelve trusted partners…
Would like to use cookies on your device…

[Verse 1]
I just came to read an article about a cat
The banner came down like a bowler hat
Accept all, decline all, manage preferences
Manage preferences leads to forty more references

[Pre-Chorus]
Legitimate interest, that's a phrase they invented
Means they take your data and call it consented

[Chorus]
Cookie banner blues, manage preferences blues
Seven hundred partners with their dirty little shoes
Cookie banner blues, the cat I came to see
Three-three-six toggles deep, please just set me free

[Verse 2]
Reject all, the page reloads to ask again
The banner has a memory like a goldfish, friend
You disabled cookies, so we can't remember
That you disabled cookies, dear December

[Chorus]
Cookie banner blues, manage preferences blues
Seven hundred partners with their dirty little shoes
Cookie banner blues, the cat I came to see
Three-three-six toggles deep, please just set me free

[Outro]
(crooner spoken) Thank you for managing your preferences…
We will remember… nothing…
